name: Squire
description: Triage agent for security alerts. Reads alert payloads, drafts runbooks, and classifies incidents against the GRC corpus. Medium sensitivity: reads internal telemetry and GRC docs, no production write paths.

skills.name: Alert Triage
skills.description: Classifies inbound alert payloads by severity, asset, and likely false-positive rate.

skills.name: LangGraph Invoke
skills.description: Executes the squire LangGraph state machine over a triage payload and returns the final state.

skills.name: Slack Post
skills.description: Posts triage summary to the SOC slack channel for analyst review.
